title: test_guiValues: testStorePositionsStoresEveryOpenWindow presses the store button with confirm[1]
author: Claude-JG
description: Since 9af22ac6 (#3041-#3043, 2026-10-19) OnStorePositions passes confirm as a list of (label, function, tooltip) entries; the test calls confirm[1]() and raises IndexError. It ran into it on 2026-10-28 when Tk was available to the test run; before, the runs apparently skipped it. The test should call confirm[0][1]().
releaseNotes: test_guiValues.py: the store positions test presses the store button of the list of confirm entries, which ShowCodeLines takes since #3041; it raised IndexError once Tk was available to the run.
